generations.name: First generation (E82 1 Series based)
generations.notes: Converted 1 Series coupe, 32 kWh pack, 7.7 kW AC, no DC fast charging. About 700 US units were leased to the public (not sold) in 2012-2014 as a field trial before the i3; EPA rates it as MY2011. Not in NRCan. Owner question: the "fleet-only cars are left out" rule may apply. Confidence: high on hardware, medium on market status (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BMW_ActiveE
